label: VERIFIED
extraction: Santa Method failure modes and mitigations: Infinite loop (reviewers keep finding new issues after fixes) - max iteration cap (3), escalate; Rubber stamping (both reviewers pass everything) - adversarial prompt 'Your job is to find problems, not approve'; Subjective drift (reviewers flag style preferences) - tight rubric with objective pass/fail only; Fix regression (fixing issue A introduces issue B) - fresh reviewers each round catch regressions; Reviewer agreement bias (both miss same thing) - mitigated by independence, add third reviewer or human spot-check for critical output; Cost explosion (too many iterations on large outputs) - batch sampling pattern, budget caps. Three implementation patterns: Pattern A (Claude Code Subagents - recommended for true context isolation), Pattern B (Sequential Inline - fallback with explicit context resets), Pattern C (Batch Sampling - for 100+ items, stratified sampling 10-15%, categorize failures, apply targeted fixes, re-sample).
